name: network_tools
description: Network diagnostics tool for ping, DNS lookup, port scanning, HTTP/HTTPS checks, traceroute, and connectivity tests. Use for: 'ping google.com', 'check if port 443 is open on example.com', 'DNS lookup for domain.com', 'check HTTP status of bigsk1.com', 'is bigsk1.com responding?', 'trace route to 8.8.8.8', 'is my internet working?'

operation.description: Type of network operation to perform

host.description: Target hostname or IP address (required for ping, dns, port, traceroute)

url.description: Target URL for HTTP/HTTPS check (can use host instead, scheme added automatically)

port.description: Target port number (required for port operation)

method.description: HTTP method for http operation (default: GET)

follow_redirects.description: Follow HTTP redirects for http operation (default: true)

count.description: Number of ping packets to send (default: 4)

test_hosts.description: List of hosts to test for connectivity check
